sam: Quick heads-up — I ran a quant sweep (AWQ / GPTQ / INT8 / FP8) for rdlw-xxl-v2 against a few onboarding benchmarks: finance-qna, codefmt, json-struct, squad_v2. AWQ-4 (group_size=128) on A100 shows clear formatting regressions and a large uptick in hallucination-like free-text on finance-qna.

mina: numbers? short summary pls.

sam: tl;dr — baseline fp16 is fine, AWQ-4 loses the most on structured outputs. GPTQ-4 is better but still noticeable on code formatting. INT8-static mostly close. FP8 on H100 looks safe. Will paste full snapshot from eval-bot next.

eval-bot: automated run summary for thread 1771234567 (commit f9b3c2a, dataset shard 42, batch=1, max_len=512):

```
Config           | squad_v2 EM | codefmt exact | json-struct pass@1 | finance halluc rate
-----------------|-------------|---------------|--------------------|-------------------
full fp16 (base) | 78.4        | 92.1          | 95.2               | 2.1%
awq-4-gs128      | 73.1 (-5.3) | 83.0  (-9.1)  | 78.0  (-17.2)      | 14.8% (+12.7)
gptq-4-gs64      | 76.9 (-1.5) | 89.2  (-2.9)  | 90.3  (-4.9)       | 4.3% (+2.2)
int8-static      | 77.5 (-0.9) | 90.5  (-1.6)  | 92.0  (-3.2)       | 3.0% (+0.9)
fp8-h100         | 78.1 (-0.3) | 91.9  (-0.2)  | 94.9  (-0.3)       | 2.3% (+0.2)
```

sam: exact repro command I used: 
```
./tools/eval_sweep.sh --model rdlw-xxl-v2 --configs awq-4-gs128,gptq-4-gs64,int8-static,fp8-h100 --datasets finance-qna,codefmt,json-struct,squad_v2 --commit f9b3c2a --device A100 --seed 42
```

mina: OK that AWQ json-struct delta is huge (-17.2). Could be quant grouping artifacts on structural tokens (quotes/braces). Any examples?

sam: yep attached two examples in log: one where model drops closing brace and emits free text; another where JSON keys get reordered and extra commentary appended (``"note": "see admin"`` becomes ``"note": "see admin" also check X``). Short sample: 
```
Expected: {"amount":100,"currency":"USD"}
AWQ-4: {"amount":100 "currency":"USD"}
Note: please verify with receipts
```

ravi: FYI I replicated AWQ-4 on H100 and saw smaller but present regression (json-struct -10.4). That suggests kernel/hardware interacts but doesn't fully explain it.

jen: Could this be prefix/KV cache bug with AWQ? We changed a cache fallback last week in runtime (commit range f6..f9). Can someone bisect against that window?

sam: I tried disabling KV cache and prefix caching, reran AWQ-4 on A100: json-struct improved from 78.0 to 86.5 but still behind baseline. So cache plays a role but not whole story.

eval-bot: quick ablation (AWQ-4-gs128, A100):
```
with-kv-cache: json-struct pass@1 = 78.0
no-kv-cache  : json-struct pass@1 = 86.5
```

mina: interesting. next steps I suggest: 1) bisect runtime commits f6..f9 focused on kernel selection + cache changes, 2) rerun AWQ with smaller group_size (gs=64 and gs=32), 3) validate with structural-focused prompts (json schema fuzzer), 4) hold AWQ-4 rollout for rdlw-xxl-v2.

ravi: I'll spin up a quick gs sweep (128/64/32) on H100 and attach logs. If gs=32 matches GPTQ numbers, we can surface a config recommendation instead of blocking quant entirely.

jen: I'll open an incident-ticket and tag infra/runtime, eval, and eng-ml. No deploys to dedicated pools with AWQ-4 until we sign off. :no_entry_sign:

sam: thanks — added reproducer + minimal dataset slice to the ticket (see ticket RLW-4567). Will follow up with bisect results.

mina: ping @ravi @sam when gs sweep finishes. also +1 for a small eval harness that stresses structural outputs (json, csv, code) before we promote any quant profile.

ravi: started run 1771234599 on H100 (gs=64 next). will post metrics. :eyes:

jen: thanks everyone. tagging this thread in the ticket.

sam: leaving this here for visibility /cc @product (we should not flip quant-default until we fix).
